findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (House roll call, 66 aye, 47 no)
findings.note: The member's vote record lists a No on second reading of HB 958. The ratified bill (https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookUp/2025/H958) requires a voter registration application to state that the applicant is a US citizen before the county board processes it, with a 30-day notice to fix a blank answer and a statement under penalty of perjury. It also directs the State Board to set up a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens by a federal database. The bill covers many other election topics.

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, M11 motion to concur in Senate changes (House roll call, 62 aye, 47 no)
findings.note: The member's vote record lists a No on the motion to concur in the Senate version of HB 958, the same omnibus with the citizenship-on-registration requirement and the federal-database voter-roll removal process. The bill page shows it was vetoed on 08/17/2026.

findings.motion: HB 1246 Safeguarding Elections Act, listed among the bill's sponsors (not the primary sponsor)
findings.note: The bill page lists Colvin among the sponsors. The filed text covers voter intimidation, threats and challenges; it has no photo ID or citizenship proof provisions. Saved because it is an election-integrity bill; the sponsor date is the referral date shown on the bill page.

Roll call lists him among the Noes on second reading. H 958 (Election Law Changes) includes provisions on photo ID and provisional ballots for voters without ID, ID copies with absentee ballots, matching ID numbers on registrations, and requiring applicants to state whether they are citizens when registering.

findings.motion: HB 958 Motion 11, concur with Senate changes (roll call 801)
findings.note: Roll call lists him among the Noes on the final vote to concur. The bill was vetoed 2026-08-17. H 958 (Election Law Changes) includes provisions on photo ID and provisional ballots for voters without ID, ID copies with absentee ballots, matching ID numbers on registrations, and requiring applicants to state whether they are citizens when registering.
